prompt: Does the searchable concept architecture accurately represent PF-ILD/PFILD, progressive fibrosing/fibrotic ILD and non-IPF PPF without inappropriate conceptual restriction?
Are AND/OR nesting, phrase grouping and contextual protection of PPF correct and unlikely to create avoidable false negatives?
Are MeSH concepts and explosion/mapping choices appropriate for ILD, pulmonary fibrosis and disease progression?
Are synonyms, acronyms, plural/hyphen variants, historical terminology and spelling variants sufficiently complete?
Are field tags, quotation marks, parentheses and query translation correct, including the v2.1-to-v2.2 Title/Abstract correction?
Are any limits/filters present, justified and unlikely to bias retrieval? Confirm that no language/date/design/disease/treatment/outcome limits were silently introduced.
Is the title-only uncontextualized PPF layer plus contextual title/abstract PPF layer an appropriate balance between recall and ambiguity?
Is the 62-record PubMed-applicable sentinel set adequate, correctly specified and representative enough for validation?
Should the 1,004-record legacy safety stratum remain separate from the controlled v2.2 stratum, be modified, or be retired after validation?
Are Emtree preferred terms, explosion choices and title/abstract/keyword field syntax correct?
Are TITLE-ABS-KEY and TITLE-only PPF layers correctly translated? Is any proximity term needed?
Are TS and TI fields and any proposed NEAR logic appropriate?
Are CINAHL Headings, explosion behavior and TI/AB syntax correct on the institutional platform?
Are MeSH descriptors and :ti,ab,kw syntax appropriate for CENTRAL?
Are Portuguese/Spanish/English terms and any DeCS concepts sufficient? Are source filters appropriate?
Are title/abstract/keyword search terms and multilingual variants sufficiently sensitive?
Are ClinicalTrials.gov plus international registry supplementation sufficient, and are publication-derived registry identifiers handled correctly?
Is one-generation backward/forward citation chasing from all 62 sentinels an appropriate supplemental method, and should additional seed generations be pre-specified?
Are the dedicated conference/thesis strategies and supplementary discovery layers sufficient, and are any additional grey-literature sources required?
Are exact strategies, execution dates/times, hit counts, raw exports, checksums, search histories and source-access failures documented to PRISMA-S quality?
Choose: accept / accept with minor revisions / revise and resubmit / reconstruct. List every change required before the identification strategy is frozen.
